decision.permitted_role: Measure the exact q32/q64/q128 prefix-task reduction and decide whether q64 replaces q32 inside a later composite optimization; do not promote this mechanism alone as the selected 1.15 contribution.

identity.catalog_population: M73 disjoint DSEC train-only S32 over 18 sequences

m41_h67_int8_bridge.permitted_role: future elastic-width PWP input identity only; not used in early-hit arithmetic

independent_catalog_structure_audit.implication: Every newly exact row counted by E32-E16, E64-E32 or E128-E64 has popcount at least two and is matcher-eligible. E16 itself is not eligibility-clean because its 20 popcount-one centers can match arbitrarily many runtime rows.

q64.exact_saving_formula_after_full_replay: S64=3*F16_eligible + 2*F32 + F48, with F32=D32 and final-prefix F64 saving zero
q64.lower_bound_derivation: Credit only D32 rows, which first become exact no later than prefix2 and therefore skip prefixes3 and4: 2*1,598,983.
q64.upper_bound_derivation: Treat all E16 as eligible and all D64 as first hits in q48: 3*E16+2*D32+D64.

q128.lower_bound_derivation: Set E16 eligibility credit to zero, place all D64 at prefix4 and all D128 at final prefix8: 6*D32+4*D64.
q128.upper_bound_derivation: Treat all E16 as eligible, place all D64 at prefix3 and all D128 at prefix5: 7*E16+6*D32+5*D64+3*D128.

aggregate_only_bounds.why_the_lower_bounds_are_safe_but_incomp: Nested exact-hit sets are monotone, and every new center after q16 has popcount at least two. However, aggregate q64 does not reveal whether its new hits arrived at q48 or q64, aggregate q128 does not reveal q80/q96/q112 first hits, and aggregate E16 does not separate eligible from popcount-one rows.

q64_threshold_audit.frozen_q32_comparison_condition: 3*F16_eligible + F48 >= 5,272,155, after the fixed 2*D32 credit, is necessary and sufficient for q64 to be at least one cycle faster than frozen M397 q32.
q64_threshold_audit.same_mechanism_q32_comparison_condition: q32 itself saves F16_eligible. Therefore q64 beats early-hit q32 only if 2*F16_eligible + F48 >= 5,272,155 after the fixed 2*D32 credit.
q64_threshold_audit.proof: The q64 early-hit theoretical upper bound is 16,301,928 cycles, less than the required 32,136,034 cycles. No missing q48 distribution can close that gap.

global_standalone_gate_audit.q16: No extra serial16 prefix exists, so exact early termination saves zero matcher cycles.
global_standalone_gate_audit.conclusion: Only q64 can still change the q32/q64 ordering. No M397 q/O point can cross the frozen 1.15 gate with distance-zero early termination alone.

frozen_minimum_execution_contract.name: M399_H67_NESTED_EXACT_EARLYHIT_PREFIX_REPLAY_R1

exact_match_rule.prefix_task: One cycle compares the current row against exactly 16 resident centers and returns prefix-local minimum distance and lowest lane ID.
exact_match_rule.running_tie_break: Update only for a smaller distance or an equal distance with smaller global center ID.
exact_match_rule.legal_early_stop: After a complete 16-center prefix, stop before issuing the next prefix only when the registered running best_distance equals zero.
exact_match_rule.why_lossless: Hamming distance cannot improve below zero. All later center IDs are larger because the catalog is nested in ID order; a later exact duplicate could not beat the already selected lower ID, and the frozen catalog has no within-partition duplicates.
forbidden_stops: mid-prefix after only a subset of 16 lanes
popcount-one or zero-row bypass credited again as an early-hit saving

matcher_recurrence.stop_prefix: first prefix whose cumulative best_distance is zero, otherwise P
matcher_recurrence.decision_latency: The prefix result is registered at the normal task boundary; no extra cycle is assumed. Any implemented controller bubble must be measured and added as a named component.
matcher_recurrence.task_server: One shared serial16 prefix task per cycle; no SYSTOLIC_Q, parallel-q or WIDE credit.

mandatory_full_phase_statistics: For every phase and prefix q16/q32/q48/q64/q80/q96/q112/q128: cumulative all-nonzero exact hits and cumulative eligible exact hits.
For every phase: eligible first-zero-prefix histogram F16/F32/F48/F64/F80/F96/F112/F128 plus no-exact eligible rows.
Executed and skipped prefix-task counts, with skipped tasks equal the matcher-cycle delta exactly.
Separate popcount-zero, popcount-one and popcount-at-least-two row counts; never infer eligible E16 from all-nonzero E16.
Reproduce M397 E16/E32/E64/E128 aggregates, q-specific selected centers, distances, PWP/fallback work, used centers and maximal runs with zero mismatch.

unchanged_m397_resources_and_cycles.pattern_config: load the full q table before matching; early termination does not reduce config bytes or commands
unchanged_m397_resources_and_cycles.descriptor_sram: 48-bit descriptors, one II1/L8/D8 stream, same writes and 8/O replayed reads
unchanged_m397_resources_and_cycles.pwp_stride: q16/O8=1152 B, q32/O4=576 B, q64/O2=288 B, q128/O1=160 B physical for 144 B useful
unchanged_m397_resources_and_cycles.commands: one pattern command per phase; each nonempty tile has one weight command plus one command per q-specific maximal used-center run
unchanged_m397_resources_and_cycles.tile_recurrence: first tile DMA exposed; only tile t+1 DMA overlaps tile t replay; last replay exposed; no cross-phase overlap
unchanged_m397_resources_and_cycles.baseline: the same 742148386-cycle H67 bit-sparse comparator for every q/O point

fair_selection_rule.winner_comparison: Compare early-hit q64 against early-hit q32. A comparison against frozen q32 may be reported only as a separately labeled bridge, not as the fair architectural winner.
fair_selection_rule.standalone_gate: The precomputed mathematical upper bounds already close 1.15 admission for this mechanism alone; execution may not override the NO_GO by changing another component.

mandatory_outputs: Per-phase prefix histogram JSON/CSV and aggregate first-hit histogram
Matcher reference/executed/saved task ledger for q32/q64/q128
Exact before/after candidate cycle component ledger in which matcher is the only changed M397 component unless a named controller overhead is added
q64 versus frozen-q32 and early-hit-q32 cycle deltas
Double-sealed analyzer, contract, output and receipt
negative_controls: Stop on best_distance==1 and require a later exact-center counterexample to change the selected result and fail.
Credit all E16 rows as eligible and require the popcount-class ledger to fail.
Delete q48 or q80/q96/q112 records and require the first-hit histogram completeness gate to fail.
Save a fractional or mid-prefix cycle when lane 0 finds zero and require the one-task-per-prefix ledger to fail.
Apply early-hit only to q64 while calling the comparison against unoptimized q32 fair and require the selection gate to fail.
Change any PWP/fallback decision, center ID, run, DMA byte, stride, replay or baseline cycle and require component identity to fail.
Insert an unreported stop-decision bubble and require cycle attribution to fail.
Substitute SYSTOLIC_Q, WIDE144 or a PAFT runtime count and require resource/identity checks to fail.

findings.title: M397 exact-hit aggregates are not eligibility-clean at q16
findings.detail: M397 increments exact_pattern_hits for every nonzero distance-zero row, independently of strict use_pwp or popcount>=2 matcher eligibility. M338 contains 20 popcount-one centers in the first q16 prefix. Those rows already bypass all extra serial16 passes, so E16 cannot be credited without a full eligibility split.

findings.title: Missing intermediate prefixes prevent exact cycle accounting
findings.detail: E64 does not distinguish first hits at q48 from q64, while E128 does not distinguish q80/q96/q112/q128. Only the former groups save 1 or 3/2/1 later prefix tasks. Full 17,280-phase replay must emit cumulative and first-hit eligible histograms at every 16-center boundary.

findings.title: The mechanism must be applied to q32 for a fair q64 winner comparison
findings.detail: An eligible exact hit in q16 saves q32's second prefix as well as three later prefixes in q64. Comparing early-hit q64 only against frozen, unoptimized q32 overstates q64's architectural advantage. Both deltas must be reported, with early-hit q32 used for final selection.

findings.title: The 1.15 standalone gate is mathematically closed before execution
findings.detail: Even the most favorable placement of every frozen exact hit saves at most 3,781,137/16,301,928/50,829,770 matcher cycles for q32/q64/q128, below their respective 1.15 deficits. Prefix replay remains useful for q32/q64 ranking and later composition, not as a standalone admitted contribution.

findings.title: q128 early-hit alone cannot catch frozen q32
findings.detail: q128 starts 61,363,109 cycles behind frozen q32, exceeding its 50,829,770-cycle theoretical early-hit upper bound. The q80/q96/q112 replay can close the ledger but cannot reverse this proof.

findings.title: The early-stop prefix controller has no RTL/DC evidence
findings.detail: The cycle contract assumes a registered zero decision with no extra bubble on one shared serial16 task server. VCS must verify exact center/tie behavior and task counts; DC must later show that zero-detect/control does not change the common frequency.

findings.title: The dominant q32 term remains SHARED96 active compute
findings.detail: M397 records 581,068,416 non-additive active-compute cycles for q32. Early-hit changes matcher tasks only and leaves PWP base service, residual work, DMA, SRAM and replay untouched, so it cannot by itself address the dominant term.

findings.title: Elastic-width PWP is a separate next hypothesis
findings.detail: M41 provides checkpoint-bound H67 INT8 weights. A future exact q32/O4 experiment may store a 96-byte low8 block plus a separately aligned 64-byte high4 sidecar only for blocks that are not sign extensions. Capacity-only worst case is 64 config + 6,144 weight + 32*(384 + 4*64) = 26,688 bytes, which fits 32 KiB. The non-sign-extension incidence, DMA commands, cycles and exact reconstruction are unmeasured and must not be mixed into M399 early-hit numbers.
